Extinction (ext).'), p.118-119 (Table A.5 Olson, footnote c 'Potentiometer (pot). Maximum (max).')

method: 1) limit_type_report is decided only for the 33 rows that were 'unclear' after the audit (29 original + O5b, O16, P21a, P21b), from the 'Test observations and anomalies' cell of the SAME test id in Summary Report Table A.3 (P tests) or A.5 (O tests). For the other 21 rows it is left '' and the previous audited type is quoted in the basis; the report observation is quoted so a contradiction would be visible (none was found). 2) Settings are copied as written (pot = control-box potentiometer setting; fan = fan display = fan volts x10, ReadMe [p19]). A test value counts as cm/s only where the table cell or the report writes 'cm/s'. 3) Conversion: only when the workbook has a block whose DATE cell equals the table Date (workbook GMT cell also checked against the report's GMT day) and only at a pot/fan value that appears in a row of the matching restrictor band; no interpolation, no extrapolation, no other-date fallback. The air value read from the workbook is taken as cm/s because ReadMe [p20] says 'Air display:  flow speed measured in the duct in cm/s on the video display' and report p.13 says the overlay displayed the 'air velocity transducer reading (cm/s)'. The example column E ('U cm/s*', A33 '*U =1.0066(AIR)', A34 'Based on SPICE fan calibration data ... (centerline)') exists only in the example block A:E and is NOT applied. 4) RESTRICTOR LABEL CAVEAT (applies to every converted value): the restrictor labels exist only in column D of the example block (D4 'no restrictor', D14 '1 restrictor', D23 '2 resrictor'); the dated blocks repeat the same three bands (each headed by 'decr' / 'Air' cells) without their own label. The band-to-restrictor mapping used here (third band = 2 restrictors, second = 1) rests on D1 ('Data is organized by number of restrictors used') plus that layout, and is consistent with report p.74 ('With no restrictors, the maximum flow velocity was ~55 cm/s, and with two restrictors this was reduced to a maximum of ~35 cm/s'; e.g. 2014-06-23 first band AC7 = 55, third band AC26 = 36). It is a positional reading, so no converted value is marked 'direct'. 5) confidence refers to the cm/s fields: 'derived' when at least one cm/s end is filled; 'unclear' when both are empty (nothing established in cm/s). The limit_type_report decision is supported by the verbatim quote in limit_type_report_basis.

limits: 1) No complete bracket in cm/s for any row. The quench limits sit at pot 0.26-0.38, and the calibration tabulates only pots 10, 8, 6, 4, 2, 1, 0.5 (1.6 on some July days in the first band) and 0. Interpolation was not allowed, so every quench end is empty. Only single ends were found: hi for blowoffs O5a (14), O10 (32, loose: whole flame out at maximum), O11 (20), O17 (11); hi = 5 for O3a from the report's own 'cm/s'; lo = 0 for the fan-to-zero rows P5 and P13a. 2) Dates without a calibration block: 6/13/2014 (O3a, O3b), 6/16/2014 (P1, P2, P3a, P3b), 7/30/2014 (P18, P20, P23, P24), 2/26/2016 (O20, O21, O22). 3) Restrictor labels appear only in the example block's column D. The mapping of the dated blocks' bands to restrictor counts is positional (see method) and is the main assumption behind every converted value, so none is 'direct'. 4) For the blowoff rows O7, O8b and O9, the report gives the instantaneous fan reading at blowoff (97, 78, 68). These differ from the cell's commanded pot (10, 6.0, 4.0 -> calibrated fan 122, 88.5, 72) and are not tabulated, so they were left empty as DISCREPANCIA. For O5a and O11 the converted hi is the commanded pot's steady calibrated flow, which may exceed the flow at the moment of blowoff. 5) O18: the calibration (8 at pot 4) disagrees with the in-test Air display (11), and the 2014-07-28 two-restrictor band peaks at 22 against the report's ~35 maximum; left empty. The 2014-07-29 block repeats band values (anomaly; affects P12, P17, neither converted). 6) Unsettled rows: O2, O3b, O13b, P3b, P15 (observation silent on the outcome), P19 (extinction mixed with 'sample mostly gone'), P21a (self-extinction at constant flow), O20, O21 (not in the report). 7) Consistency issue for the reviewer: under the task rule, P2, P4 and P6 ('fan off' / 'turned off flow') are 'none'. The audit kept P5 and P13a (fan turned to 0) as quench with 'fan-to-zero, bracket only'. Physically it is the same action, and the rule should be harmonised. 8) The air display has a ~1 min response (ReadMe [p20]) and units-only resolution of +/-0.5 cm/s (report p.74). Calibration was done at the end of each operational day (report p.74), not at the test instant. 9) P22a (final O2 0.6) is flagged ANOMALY_PSI_O2 and excluded from limit minima. P22b's final O2 of 39.1 is also anomalous but is not flagged.
